title: Unit Event — This Moment With You!

meta.Outline: Leo/need's debut single is taking off. Thanks to the impact of their VIRTUAL SINGER version, their label expresses hopes that the band will create VIRTUAL SINGER versions of all future songs. But Ichika seems hesitant...

rows.Line: Solis Records

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Hello, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hello!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What are we gonna talk about today, Mr. Shindo?! Oh, do you have the sales figures for our debut song...?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki, calm down.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Why? I know for sure that we're gonna hear some good news today!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I mean...
Everyone's been talking about our song♪

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Yes, you're certainly right.
I'd like to begin by discussing that with you all.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Your song has shattered our projections.
It's already brought in double what we were initially expecting. We couldn't have asked for a better start.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Congratulations.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You two did come up with a pretty amazing song, Saki, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe! We did it, Ichi♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah...! I'm so glad...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes, the song itself is very good, but the VIRTUAL SINGER version becoming a big hit has played a key role in its success.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, hasn't that already reached around eight million views...?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I remember us marveling at it getting a million views after it'd gone up. But that number just kept increasing, which was a little scary...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Haha. That's perfectly understandable.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: But the VIRTUAL SINGER version did give our sales figures a massive boost...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes, it worked as a nice piece of advertisement. Many people apparently decided to listen to the Leo/need version after hearing it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: That phenomenon got a few of us in the office talking with regards to what your band should do moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I'd like to discuss that with you today.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What we should do moving forward...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: If you don't feel comfortable with this idea, that's okay.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: But we were thinking that you could produce Leo/need and VIRTUAL SINGER versions of every song that you write in the future.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: For every song we write?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: As I just stated, uploading the VIRTUAL SINGER version provided us with a huge benefit...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: We've even received word about you doing a collaboration on the condition that you produce a VIRTUAL SINGER version.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wait, a collaboration...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes, it involves the Oishi Beverage Company's sodas.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
W-Wait, don't tell me...
FizzYum Cider?!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Correct, Ms. Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's a pretty big company.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But why us...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Your debut song becoming such a big success is the main reason...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Another is how your band's image seems to go well with the theme of the commercial they're currently producing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Our band's image?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Yes.
The theme for their next commercial is “This Moment With You!”

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: The idea is to capture the smooth and refreshing taste of their beverages via students enjoying their youth.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: And Leo/need apparently checks all the boxes in terms of who they want to appear in it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This moment with you...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, that does sound like us...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Their commercials always have lots of kids our age having fun at the pool or riding their bikes and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Seeing those commercials made me want to enjoy life the same way as those kids!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I remember you saying that when we were little.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's wonderful that we're being given this opportunity to appear in one of their commercials, but...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: If there's something on your mind, Ms. Hoshino, please don't be afraid to speak up.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, I'm grateful that we're being given such a nice opportunity...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But the thought of having Miku also sing all of our songs moving forward worries me...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're worried...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I don't know how to describe it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm really sorry. I know it'll help advertise our songs, and how we're being asked to make one for this collaboration...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I can't shake this feeling...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Ms. Hoshino...
Let me use this moment to tell you how I feel as both your producer and manager.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: First, to reiterate what I just said, simultaneously producing VIRTUAL SINGER versions of your songs should be hugely beneficial.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Just like what happened this time around, they'll help increase the odds of your song getting listened to and shared on social media. In other words, they'll boost our sales figures.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Obviously, that'll be a good thing for both this company and your band. Furthermore, they won't take anything away from the music you produce as Leo/need.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: R-Right...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Alright, that's how I feel as a producer.
Now, let me say this as your manager...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Ms. Hoshino...
I have to think that there's a reason why you feel so uncomfortable about all this.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Regardless of what we all decide, it won't be good to move things along without dealing with that first.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: So, for the longevity of your career, it'll be important to talk about this now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: For the longevity of our career...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes. This company is heavily in favor of your band producing VIRTUAL SINGER versions of all your songs in the future.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: However, I don't believe you have to do what this company says verbatim every single time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Of course, letting you all do whatever you want won't lead to any good outcomes.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: However, if this is a matter of conviction as opposed to simple wants or desires, then you shouldn't be afraid to speak your minds.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But this collaboration hangs on us producing a VIRTUAL SINGER version, right...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: That's right.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: But this is a matter that's going to have long-term consequences, so I recommend that you try to reach a consensus before making any hasty decisions.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: How long do we have to decide...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: They've given you until the end of the month.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Understood...
We promise to let you know our answer by then.
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm sorry about not allowing us to give a quick response. I know you're all really excited about this collaboration...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, don't apologize!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Mr. Shindo even said that we shouldn't go ahead until we're all on the same page!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right. This collaboration isn't all that's involved. This matter is going to affect how we do things moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That being said...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Do you know why you're so bothered by this, Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's the thing. I'm not really sure myself...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I keep getting this weird feeling.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I see...
I wish I could help you somehow...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: In any case, let's take our time with this since we still have plenty of time to think.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Slow and steady!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Plus, we're having that party in SEKAI to mark our debut song becoming a big success♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, let's celebrate first, and then think this through!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
I forgot that we were having that party today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Since it's our big event, why don't we go buy some snacks for it?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Sounds good.
Actually, if we don't, they're probably going to ask us why we didn't bring any.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe. Right.
I can see it already.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha♪ Then, let's go grab some snacks and head over to see Miku and the others!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: All the moments we've spent together as Leo/need, as well as all the moments I've spent with Miku...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Both of those things mean a great deal to me, so my goal will be to channel those feelings into this song.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And that's why I'd like to have Miku sing it too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Understood...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: That shouldn't be a problem, so let's get the ball rolling for this collaboration, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I'm sorry for making you all wait...
Let's do our best to produce a great song for this collaboration.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Let's make it the best song ever!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Writing this song is obviously important, but please also make sure to keep practicing.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Don't forget that you need to start preparing for Jam Fest soon.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
He's right.
We also need to give that everything we have.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We get to perform in our first show as pros at Jam Fest, so we need to make it a successful performance...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We're going to blow everyone away by writing the best song ever for this collaboration and by putting on an amazing performance at Jam Fest.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Let's all do our best!
